physical_passthrough.reason: Existing XNU UFS transport emits physical UTRD/UCD/PRDT addresses. Its known upstream implementation uses a disabled-translation context. No qualified iOS16 UFS IOVA allocator/map/unmap/TLBI/lifetime integration is present. UEFI/GPU page-table probes do not establish that integration.
physical_passthrough.limits: All software addresses/lengths are validated. Physical pass-through still permits DMA beyond the allocation if controller state/descriptors are wrong; software checks are not SMMU isolation.
